## Statements

- Stated by vendor (mimo-deep-thinking, Important Notes, Multi-turn Conversation Pass-through Requirements): On turns with tool calls, send reasoning content back unchanged. Dropping it lowers instruction following and raises hallucination; OpenCode and Goose are named as affected tools.
- Stated by vendor (mimo-models, Text Generation Model, deprecation notice; Quick Selection Guide): MiMo V2.6 (pro, flash) replaces V2.5, which retires on 2026-10-21. Use V2.6 for new work; ultraspeed is a contact-sales tier with no Pitwall route.
